notes_for_editor: Four pages were read: the tnlandforms.us North Carolina tower list (map revised June 2021), the OpenStreetMap way, and the NHLR and FFLOS North Carolina listings. Two searches gave no history for this tower. The name link between Tirzah (tnlandforms list) and Glenns Mountain Fire Tower (OpenStreetMap) comes from the brief's records; neither page names the other, so please confirm it before publishing. The OSM page was not checked for coordinates. The brief's status 'standing' rests only on the OSM map entry. Design, height, build date, staffing, agency and access are unknown and omitted. The NHLR page shows 31 lookouts and no Tirzah, which supports 'not registered' by inspection of the full list. A Mapcarta search snippet placed the tower in 'Mount Tirzah Township'; it was not read, so it is not used. Read budget ran over: about nine fetch_text calls, including one failed NHLR request, and the early reads were partly repeated. Fact check 2026-10-09: the OSM page names only Glenns Mountain Fire Tower and the tnlandforms list does not mention Glenns, so the name link is still the brief's own and no source confirms it. The NHLR North Carolina page was read in full: 31 names, no Tirzah. The FFLOS page names Big Stamp Lookout Site and Frye Knob. The story now says 'lookout register' (both registers are national) and drops 'north-central', which no source states.
